mapper.data: {"sql":"UPDATE cars SET filter_reason = f.r, status = CASE WHEN f.r IS NULL THEN 'passed' ELSE 'filtered_out' END, updated_at = datetime('now') FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN s.budget_max <> '' AND c.price > CAST(s.budget_max AS INTEGER) THEN 'дороже бюджета' WHEN s.mileage_max <> '' AND c.mileage > CAST(s.mileage_max AS INTEGER) THEN 'пробег выше лимита' WHEN s.year_min <> '' AND c.year < CAST(s.year_min AS INTEGER) THEN 'год ниже лимита' WHEN s.fuel <> '' AND c.fuel IS NOT NULL AND instr(','||replace(lower(s.fuel),' ','')||',', ','||lower(c.fuel)||',') = 0 THEN 'не то топливо' WHEN s.gearbox <> '' AND c.gearbox IS NOT NULL AND lower(c.gearbox) <> lower(trim(s.gearbox)) THEN 'не та коробка' WHEN s.makes <> '' AND instr(lower(s.makes), lower(ifnull(c.make,'#'))) = 0 AND instr(lower(s.makes), lower(ifnull(c.model,'#'))) = 0 THEN 'не та марка/модель' ELSE (SELECT 'стоп-слово: '||trim(j.value) FROM json_each('[\"'||replace(s.stopwords, ',', '\",\"')||'\"]') j WHERE trim(j.value) <> '' AND instr(lower(ifnull(c.title,'')||' '||ifnull(c.description,'')), lower(trim(j.value))) > 0 LIMIT 1) END AS r FROM cars c, (SELECT ifnull(MAX(CASE WHEN key='budget_max' THEN value END),'') AS budget_max, ifnull(MAX(CASE WHEN key='mileage_max' THEN value END),'') AS mileage_max, ifnull(MAX(CASE WHEN key='year_min' THEN value END),'') AS year_min, ifnull(MAX(CASE WHEN key='fuel' THEN value END),'') AS fuel, ifnull(MAX(CASE WHEN key='gearbox' THEN value END),'') AS gearbox, ifnull(MAX(CASE WHEN key='makes' THEN value END),'') AS makes, ifnull(MAX(CASE WHEN key='stopwords' THEN value END),'') AS stopwords FROM settings) s WHERE c.listing_id = ?1) f WHERE cars.listing_id = ?1 AND cars.status = 'new' RETURNING listing_id, source, url, title, make, model, price, mileage, year, fuel, gearbox, power_kw, location, seller_type, description, status, filter_reason","params":["{{2.id}}"]}

{"sql":"SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars o, cars c WHERE c.listing_id=?1 AND o.listing_id<>c.listing_id AND lower(o.model)=lower(c.model) AND abs(o.year-c.year)<=2 AND abs(o.mileage-c.mileage)<=40000 AND o.price>0) AS comp_n, (SELECT CAST(AVG(o.price) AS INTEGER) FROM cars o, cars c WHERE c.listing_id=?1 AND o.listing_id<>c.listing_id AND lower(o.model)=lower(c.model) AND abs(o.year-c.year)<=2 AND abs(o.mileage-c.mileage)<=40000 AND o.price>0) AS comp_avg, (SELECT MIN(o.price) FROM cars o, cars c WHERE c.listing_id=?1 AND o.listing_id<>c.listing_id AND lower(o.model)=lower(c.model) AND abs(o.year-c.year)<=2 AND abs(o.mileage-c.mileage)<=40000 AND o.price>0) AS comp_min, (SELECT MAX(o.price) FROM cars o, cars c WHERE c.listing_id=?1 AND o.listing_id<>c.listing_id AND lower(o.model)=lower(c.model) AND abs(o.year-c.year)<=2 AND abs(o.mileage-c.mileage)<=40000 AND o.price>0) AS comp_max, (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='score_threshold') AS threshold, (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='paused') AS paused, (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='tg_chat_id') AS chat, (SELECT group_concat(key||'='||value, ', ') FROM settings WHERE key IN ('w_price','w_risk','w_age_km','w_seller')) AS weights, (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='hu_min_year') AS hu_min, (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='send_all_matches') AS send_all","params":["{{2.id}}"]}

{"sql":"UPDATE cars SET red_flags=?1, risk_score=?2, market_price=?3, deal_score=?4, verdict='🔧 '||ifnull(?6,'КПП/мотор/ржавчина: не указано — проверить при осмотре')||char(10)||?5, status=CASE WHEN CAST(?7 AS TEXT)='1' THEN 'filtered_out' ELSE 'scored' END, filter_reason=CASE WHEN CAST(?7 AS TEXT)='1' THEN 'дефект по тексту: '||ifnull(?6,'') ELSE filter_reason END, updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE listing_id='{{2.id}}' RETURNING listing_id, title, url, price, mileage, year, fuel, gearbox, location, seller_type, red_flags, risk_score, market_price, deal_score, verdict, status","params":{{7.json}}}
